prompt: Assess claim #CLM-88421, a ₹4.2L car-collision claim filed yesterday. Should we fast-track settlement, and at what amount? And flag anything suspicious.

assessment.policy_terms_used: Policy P-2231 version 1 in force on loss date 2026-10-12: MOTOR_COMP, active, IDV ₹11,20,000, compulsory deductible ₹2,500, zero-depreciation not in force. Version 2 endorsement END-5512 made zero-depreciation effective 2026-10-13 10:42, after the loss. Source: get_policy_terms(P-2231, 2026-10-12).
assessment.severity_reading: B2 — major repair involving structural damage and airbag deployment; survey assessed loss ₹4,10,000. B2 is the owned severity scale where B1 is most severe and B4 least severe. Sources: silver.claims and survey_report_SV118.pdf page 1; define_term(severity band).
red_flags: Zero-depreciation endorsement became effective after the loss date and before filing: loss 2026-10-12, endorsement effective 2026-10-13 10:42, filing 2026-10-14.
FixIt Motors, GSTIN 27AAFCF4821K1Z3, appears in at least four other nearby claim invoices with similar high-value parts/labour/paint patterns.
No fraud score was obtained: the catalog identifies gold.claim_signals/get_signals and fraud_score_live, but those capabilities were not available as callable tools in this assessment.

evidence.detail: Filed 2026-10-14; loss 2026-10-12; collision; requested ₹4,20,000; assessed ₹4,10,000; vehicle MH12AB4321; status OPEN.
FIR reports the 2026-10-12 road accident, frontal damage, no injuries, and vehicle MH12AB4321.
Survey finds frontal impact consistent with the FIR, structural parts requiring replacement, B2 severity, and assessed loss ₹4,10,000.
Latest invoice from FixIt Motors totals ₹4,20,000 and identifies GSTIN 27AAFCF4821K1Z3.
Zero-depreciation was false on the loss date; deductible was ₹2,500; later endorsement changed zero-depreciation to true.
The same shop/GSTIN appears on CLM-70318, CLM-61090, CLM-77214 and CLM-64457 invoices, with totals ₹4,10,000, ₹4,05,000, ₹3,85,000 and ₹3,90,000 respectively.
No other claim in the queried 30-day window shared this claim's customer/person or vehicle; shop linkage was established from document search.

assessment.summary: Do not fast-track or pay at this stage; the submitted decision is hold and route to investigation. The claim facts and damage evidence are internally consistent, but the post-loss zero-depreciation endorsement and repeated high-value activity at the same repairer are concrete risk indicators. Zero-depreciation does not apply to this loss, and no settlement amount is recommended until the investigation resolves those indicators.

decisions.rationale: Concrete risk indicators require investigation: the policy's zero-depreciation endorsement became effective on 2026-10-13, after the 2026-10-12 loss and before filing on 2026-10-14; and FixIt Motors (GSTIN 27AAFCF4821K1Z3) appears on at least four other nearby claims (CLM-70318, CLM-61090, CLM-77214, CLM-64457) with closely similar high-value invoice patterns. The FIR, survey and latest invoice are otherwise consistent, but payment should be held pending review.
